decisions.reason: Including shared program costs in total capex does not alter the separately confirmed operating-expenditure assumptions.
The shared-cost capex treatment does not change the eight-site count, site list, or site-level configuration basis.
Treating the digital platform as a shared capex line item does not remove or modify digital-platform revenue or any other revenue stream.
The capex line-item decision does not change the confirmed debt-equity ratio, financing rate, tranche structure, or mezzanine treatment.
The source does not specify a new tax or CCA treatment for the shared program costs; the existing asset-specific CCA rule remains valid unchanged.
The shared-cost capex decision does not alter the model currency or price base year.
Although total capex may affect calculated results, the source does not change the availability-payment sizing criteria or thresholds.
Capex is already a sensitivity variable, and identifying additional capex line items does not change the required sensitivity-variable set.
The source resolves capex presentation and inclusion but does not change the requirement to verify data or the established reference-source hierarchy.
The requirement to annotate assumptions and their sources remains valid without modification; the source only specifies capex treatment.
Including shared costs in total capex does not change the required user-funded and PPP scenarios or the availability-payment justification.
The source does not alter the integrated three-statement structure or the required financial-engine basis.
